And I wouldn't talk with him; I wouldn't deal with him at all. And he made me promise would I come to the studio with George Estelle and Louis B. Mayer and Mickey Rooney, and that's who I had an audience with.

Now, at the time, the scale for rehearsal time was $15 an hour for a musician, you know -- no, I'm sorry, it was $5 -- it's $15 now. It was $5 an hour. Okay, so I was always kind of a good businessman, you know, where my performance was, you know; I would ask for good money.
